sentences.en: I forgot to shutter the windows before the storm hit.
sentences.zh: 暴风雨来临前我忘了关窗户。

sentences.en: I sprang out of bed and flung open the shutters.
sentences.zh: 我从床上跳起来，拉开窗帘。

sentences.en: Her windows were broken and her shutters hung crookedly.
sentences.zh: 她的窗户被打破了，窗帘歪歪扭扭地挂着。

senses.zh: 关上窗板；停业，关闭(公司、工厂等)
